description: 轻轻呼吸，先用眼睛看向两边，再小幅转头，停下来对你笑。
descriptionEn: Breathe softly, glance before a small head turn, then pause with a smile.

description: 坐稳后举起一只爪子挥两下，眨眨眼，再收好爪子微笑等你。
descriptionEn: Sit comfortably, wave one paw twice, give a wink, then settle with a smile.

description: 四爪按对角交替落地、抬起，迈着轻快的小步，偶尔瞄你一眼。
descriptionEn: Plant and lift diagonal pairs of paws in a brisk little walk, with an occasional glance at you.

description: 快速蹲下发力，空中翻一圈，落地压低缓冲，再举爪定格。
descriptionEn: A quick crouch and takeoff, one airborne somersault, a cushioned landing, then a victory pose.

description: 离开地面时四爪轻晃，尾巴也跟着摆。
descriptionEn: All four feet dangle and sway when lifted.

description: 站起来叉腰，气鼓鼓地抖两下，瞪你一眼后又消气了。
descriptionEn: Paws on hips, two indignant shakes, a pointed stare, then forgiveness.

description: 坐下来托腮，眼睛左右转着想，想通后突然站起。
descriptionEn: Sit with a paw on the cheek, look around in thought, then stand with an idea.

description: 前爪交替敲键盘，写完一行就停一下。
descriptionEn: Two paws alternate at the keyboard, pausing between lines.

description: 一块一块举起积木，轻轻叠好，扶稳后满意地看看你。
descriptionEn: Lift each block into place, steady the stack, then share a satisfied look.

description: 坐稳听音乐，脑袋点两拍，尾尖跟着轻轻打拍子。
descriptionEn: Sit and nod to the beat while the tail tip keeps time.

description: 三枚方块错开飞起，双爪轮流抛接，目光追着落点走。
descriptionEn: Toss three staggered arcs, alternate the catching paws, and follow each landing.

description: 挥动小扫帚，把灰尘扫成一颗小星星。
descriptionEn: A tiny broom gathers dust into a little star.

description: 抱住一枚大方块，小心翼翼往前挪。
descriptionEn: One oversized tile takes careful little steps to deliver.

description: 放大镜追着小虫走，找到以后开心地抬爪。
descriptionEn: A magnifier follows the bug, then a paw celebrates the discovery.

description: 小魔杖一挥，尾巴召来一串闪亮星星。
descriptionEn: A tiny wand calls a trail of stars from the radical tail.

description: 几枚方块围着根号尾巴转，想法逐渐连起来。
descriptionEn: Orbiting tiles connect into a new idea above the radical tail.

description: 戴墨镜敲键盘，写完以后自信地点点头。
descriptionEn: Sunglasses, a keyboard, and a very confident nod.

description: 轻轻跳起来，彩纸在两边洒下。
descriptionEn: A joyful hop under a shower of confetti.

description: 先吓一跳，再坐地委屈大哭；擦擦眼泪，重新鼓起勇气。
descriptionEn: Startle, sit down and cry, wipe away the tears, then try again.

description: 小铃铛响了，根号兽立刻抬起头。
descriptionEn: A bell rings and the little beast perks up.

description: 坐稳摊开书，瞳孔逐行扫过文字，读到精彩处抬头一笑。
descriptionEn: Sit with an open book, scan line by line, and look up at a good part.

description: 吹出大小泡泡，用鼻尖轻轻碰一碰。
descriptionEn: Small bubbles drift away from a curious nose.

description: 眼皮慢慢垂下，前爪往前伸，尾巴向后舒展。
descriptionEn: Sleepy eyes, paws stretched forward, and a long tail stretch.

description: 眼睛半闭，脑袋一点一点，又努力坐稳。
descriptionEn: Half-closed eyes and a head that keeps nodding off.

description: 收好四爪安稳睡着，只有呼吸和尾尖有轻微起伏。
descriptionEn: Sleep with paws tucked in, with only a soft breath and a tiny tail-tip movement.

description: 坐着揉开睡意，舒舒服服伸个懒腰，再收好双爪眯一会儿。
descriptionEn: Wake from a seated doze, enjoy a long stretch, then tuck the paws in for another moment of rest.

description: 坐稳捧好魔方，转动顶层，认真看看颜色怎样变化。
descriptionEn: Hold the cube steadily, turn the top layer, and study how the colors change.

description: 前爪忙着练习，打乱的魔方复原后闪一下。
descriptionEn: Busy paws practice a solve; the finished cube gets a sparkle.

description: 双爪触板准备，抬爪开始计时，再拍回触板停表，最后看一眼成绩。
descriptionEn: Set both paws on the pads, lift to start, tap back down to stop, then check the result.

description: 金色奖牌亮起来，根号兽开心地跳一下。
descriptionEn: A golden medal lights up a proud little victory hop.

description: 魔方转动后飞出一枚棱块，赶紧扑过去救回来。
descriptionEn: A turn ejects an edge piece, prompting a quick rescue.

description: 拿起教棒，配合顶层转动讲解一个小技巧。
descriptionEn: Use a pointer to demonstrate a top-layer turning tip.

description: 鼓起泡泡，啪的一声缩缩肩，愣一下，再害羞地笑起来。
descriptionEn: Blow a bubble, flinch at the pop, pause in surprise, then giggle.

description: 耐心等一会，轻轻提竿，发现钓到小虫后忍不住笑。
descriptionEn: Wait patiently, lift the rod, and smile at the little bug on the line.

description: 双脚站稳滑板，前爪张开保持平衡，身体和尾巴跟着转弯轻摆。
descriptionEn: Keep both feet planted on the board, spread the front paws for balance, and lean gently through each turn.

description: 躲进快递箱，再慢慢探出头来看看你。
descriptionEn: Hide in a parcel, then peek out to see who is there.

description: 喝一口汽水，忍不住小小地打个嗝。
descriptionEn: A sip of soda ends in one tiny surprise hiccup.

description: 轻轻一推，纸飞机绕过根号尾巴飞回来。
descriptionEn: A paper plane loops around the radical tail and comes back.

description: 先抬眼发现星星，伸爪接住，再把闪亮的小宝贝抱到胸前。
descriptionEn: Spot the star, catch it in a waiting paw, then bring the treasure close.

description: 撑起红白小伞，听雨点落在伞面上。
descriptionEn: A red-and-white umbrella catches the gentle rain.

description: 轻轻跳进小水坑，溅出一圈圆圆的水花。
descriptionEn: One small jump into a puddle makes a ring of round splashes.

description: 抓住气球绳，四只小爪子慢慢离开地面。
descriptionEn: Hold the balloon string and float up with dangling feet.

description: 盯着爆米花，第一声响吓得弹一下，坐稳后笑着等下一颗。
descriptionEn: Watch the popcorn, bounce at the first pop, then settle with a smile.

description: 蹑手蹑脚追蝴蝶，蝴蝶又停到鼻尖附近。
descriptionEn: Quiet little steps follow a butterfly that returns for a closer look.

description: 轻推纸船下水，坐着目送它，挥挥爪祝它一路顺风。
descriptionEn: Push the boat onto the water, watch it sail away, and wave goodbye.

description: 前爪伸出去，后爪稳稳撑住，舒服地拉伸，再慢慢收回来。
descriptionEn: Reach the front paws out, brace the back feet, enjoy the stretch, then settle.

description: 压低身子悄悄迈两步，忽然瞄到你，停住假装什么也没做。
descriptionEn: Creep forward in two small steps, spot you watching, and freeze innocently.

description: 一只脚站稳，另一只脚轻轻点拍，左右摆爪扭腰，跳一支小舞。
descriptionEn: Plant one foot while the other taps the beat, alternating paws and a gentle sway.

description: 从发光的小门后探头，再一小步跨出来。
descriptionEn: Peek through a glowing little doorway and step out.

description: 抱住一弯月亮，闭上眼睛慢慢睡着。
descriptionEn: Hug a crescent moon and drift gently into sleep.

description: 刚转两下，棱块突然弹出！愣一下，伸爪接回去，再害羞地看你一眼。
descriptionEn: Two quick turns eject an edge! Pause in surprise, catch it back into place, then share a sheepish look.
